steps: Before choosing a target, this character chooses whether this attack's type is |!physical| or |!energy|.
After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Bag of Tricks|: Before |!damage| is dealt, the defender gains 1 of the following special conditions: |§bleed§Bleed|, |§incinerate§Incinerate|, or |§poison§Poison|.

steps: Before choosing a target, this character chooses whether this attack's type is |!physical| or |!energy|.

superPowers.name: Oscorp Weaponry (Affiliation: Spider-Foes)
superPowers.body: Once per turn, while an allied character is attacking, during the |*Modify Opponent's Dice| step, it may reroll 1 opposing defense die.

superPowers.name: Hit and Run
superPowers.body: |*Action|: This character immediately makes an attack action followed by a move action. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Trick or Treat
superPowers.body: When an enemy character ends an Advance or is Placed within |!range| 4 of this character, this character may use this superpower. Choose an interactive terrain feature of |!size| 3 or less within |!range| 2 of the enemy character that was Advanced or Placed. Destroy that terrain feature. The enemy character suffers a collision as if the terrain feature had collided with it.

superPowers.name: Archnemesis (Peter Parker)
superPowers.body: When attacking |*Peter Parker|, this character may modify or reroll |!failure| results and may reroll any number of attack dice. At the start of this character's Activation, if there is a non-Dazed enemy |*Peter Parker| within |!range| 3 of this character, this character's first action must be an attack action targeting that |*Peter Parker|, if possible.

superPowers.body: This character cannot Interact with or hold objective tokens. During the |*Power Phase|, roll 5 dice. For each |!critical|, |!wild|, and |!hit| rolled, this character gains 1 |!power|.

erratas.body: Stamina increased from 7 to 8 on Healthy side, and from 5 to 6 on Injured side.
Both the official digital and printed card show a pre-errata Pumpkin Bombs as well as the old Leadership. Jarvis still shows the correct Injured side from Card Pack 2022 (CA10).
Pumpkin Bombs' Strength increased from 4 to 5 on the Healthy side.
Pumpkin Bombs' Strength increased from 5 to 6 on the Injured side.
Oscorp Weaponry does not require the attacking character to pay 1 |!power|.
